rules.statement: All state elements shall be clocked only by the rising edge of i_clk, with no other clock, no gated clock and no latch.
Every flip-flop shall take its reset value at once, without waiting for an i_clk edge.
Outputs shall be o_txd = 1, o_tx_ready = 1, o_rx_valid = 0, o_rx_data = 0, o_rx_frame_err = 0, o_rx_overrun = 0.

rules.condition: While i_rst_n is 0, even when i_tx_valid = 1 and o_tx_ready = 1
rules.statement: No transmit byte shall be accepted.
The receiver shall not detect a start bit and shall not deliver a byte.
Both i_rxd synchronizer flip-flops and any flip-flop holding the previous synchronised line value shall reset to 1.
The frame shall be abandoned and o_txd shall become 1 at once.
The rest of the frame and the byte shall not be sent after the release.
The partly received frame shall be discarded and shall not produce o_rx_valid, o_rx_frame_err or o_rx_overrun after the release.
The held byte shall be discarded.
The transmitter shall be idle with o_tx_ready = 1 and shall accept a byte at the first edge after the release.

rules.condition: First edge R1 after reset release
rules.statement: The previous synchronised value s(R1-1) shall be taken as 1, so s(R1) = 0 is detected as T0.
